name: 89147 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89147 (Las Vegas) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89147 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89147 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
